{{Quote|Our fleet will hide at the system's edge so I can monitor your mission and guide you. If something goes wrong, we'll come running.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Oteg]]|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Taral system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taral V]].
